For example, it was highly prohibited to have relationships with someone of your same sub-gender. This law became even stricter after the great decline in population that affected the world. People could go to jail and have their entire life ruined if such a crime were found to be true – if they were found guilty of being deviants.

Their country’s constitution was based on wolf-god’s laws – their sacred book said that a relationship could take place only if the couple could produce a progeny.

Non-virgin, non-mated wolfs were considered trash and disposable, often leading to them spend their life running and hiding. The only way how to survive and have a decent life, was to mate with someone with different sub-gender. 

Because of the increasing pollution which lead to infertility, the amount of alphas greatly drop to desperate numbers, nearing extinction, which would be catastrophic and could lead to the end of the world they knew.
